# TrueBlue’s Centerline Named a 2026 Top Company for Women to Work in Trucking


October 15, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e4a535738b81e6c804c839ebbfb4582e/trueblue/news/2026-10-15_TrueBlue_s_Centerline_Named_a_2026_Top_Company_478.pdf)


*Recognition highlights commitment to supporting women’s careers and strengthening the transportation workforce*


TACOMA, Wash.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- TrueBlue (NYSE: TBI), a leading provider of specialized workforce solutions, today announced that its transportation staffing leader, Centerline, has been named a 2026 “Top Company for Women to Work in Trucking” by the Women in Trucking Association (WIT). This list recognizes employers focused on attracting and retaining women in the trucking industry.


“At TrueBlue, our mission is to connect people and work. Through Centerline, we’re creating opportunities for women to build meaningful careers in transportation while helping customers access the skilled talent they need,” said Taryn Owen, President and CEO of TrueBlue. “We’re honored to receive this recognition which reflects our commitment to strengthening the workforce and supporting the future of the industry.”


Women currently make up two-thirds of the Centerline team, with many holding management and leadership positions across the organization. Centerline supports their success through a culture rooted in respect, safety, and career development. Through its Respect the Drive™ program, the company also recognizes drivers and customer partners who help create better workplace experiences through their commitment to safety, inclusion, and driver support.


“Women contribute to every part of our business, and we want them to see a future for themselves here,” said Jill Quinn, President of Centerline and Skilled Trades. “That means listening to our team members, recognizing their contributions, and providing opportunities to take the next step in their careers. We’re proud to earn this recognition and grateful to the people who make Centerline a place where women can succeed.”


“Centerline has been recognized as a 2026 Top Company for Women to Work in Trucking by Redefining the Road, the official magazine for the Women in Trucking Association,” said Brian Everett, Group Publisher and Editorial Director. “This organization has earned this prestigious recognition through a rigorous nomination and review process, along with industry-wide voting that validates the nomination. We are pleased to bestow this well-earned recognition to Centerline.”


The recognition follows a nomination review and an industry-wide vote involving more than 18,000 transportation professionals, including business leaders, operations and safety specialists, human resources executives, and professional drivers. Evaluation criteria include a supportive culture, competitive pay and benefits, flexible work arrangements, professional development, and opportunities for advancement.


To learn more about Centerline, visit[centerlinedrivers.com](https://www.centerlinedrivers.com/) .
